Hero.description: I design and build high-performance software systems focused on clean architecture, exceptional UX, and cutting-edge technologies.

card1.title: Clean Code by default
card1.description: Maintainability and readability are the gold standard. I write code that teams can understand, scale, and evolve without friction.

card2.title: Performance as a standard
card2.description: Technical optimization is not optional. Every millisecond matters — I design architectures that deliver fast and fluid experiences by default.

card3.title: Creative UX/UI as a priority
card3.description: Software must be beautiful and functional. I fuse visual storytelling with immersive interactions to create products users remember.
